announcement.text: MedHelp v1.1 — Research skills, PubMed updates, and plugin ecosystem now supported

hero.subtitle: MedHelp® brings agent chat, evidence monitoring, the resource library, task pipelines, files, and compute into one focused entry point for clinical data research.

trust.title: Built for researchers at leading institutions

capabilities.title: Platform at a Glance
capabilities.subtitle: Everything a clinical research team needs, unified in a single intelligent workspace.

skills.label: Research Skills
skills.desc: Literature, data, statistics, figures, writing, and submission workflows

formats.label: Database Types
formats.desc: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite and more

agents.label: Multi-Agent Workflows
agents.desc: Parallel agent orchestration for complex studies

workspace.label: Unified Workspace
workspace.desc: Chat, files, tasks, pipelines — one entry point

ecosystem.title: Reusable Skills for
ecosystem.subtitle: From fresh PubMed literature to real-world database extraction, MedHelp turns repeated research work into callable skills, templates, and plugins so each new project starts with leverage.

database.title: Medical Databases and Data Access
database.subtitle: Database access is MedHelp's foundation layer, not something replaced by skills. The platform keeps database introduction, permission boundaries, variable retrieval, and export workflows available for skills to call when research tasks need data.
database.featureDesc: Provide one entry point for clinical cohorts, public datasets, file-based data, and private data services, with access scoped for individuals, teams, or customers.

catalog.title: Database Catalog
catalog.desc: Show data sources, variable directories, dictionaries, and availability before users start extracting data.

sources.title: Multi-Source Access
sources.desc: Support relational databases, public medical datasets, cohort files, Parquet/CSV/XLSX, and private institutional data services.

permissions.title: Permissions and Delivery Boundaries
permissions.desc: Control database access by user, team, or API token, useful when the raw database should not be copied to customers.

exports.title: Variable Search and Export
exports.desc: Search variables by research question, then produce field packages, SQL/extraction plans, and exports for statistical analysis.

spotlight.title: Latest PubMed Monitoring
spotlight.desc: Search new papers around your topic and save variables, endpoints, and evidence sentences into the knowledge base.

details.title: Topic refresh
details.desc: Generate reusable queries around diseases, exposures, outcomes, or database names.

details.title: Candidate detection
details.desc: Capture variables, scores, endpoints, and design signals from titles and abstracts.

details.title: Knowledge capture
details.desc: Save PMID, evidence sentences, and match status as traceable research assets.

pubmed.title: PubMed / Literature Updates
pubmed.desc: Track recent papers, identify variables and risk scores, and structure abstracts into usable evidence snippets.

literature.title: Reviews and Real Citations
literature.desc: Organize search, screening, citation tracing, and evidence grading around PICO and inclusion criteria.

database.title: Medical Database Extraction
database.desc: Prepare variable manifests, SQL, and export packages for MIMIC, NHANES, CHARLS, and more.

analysis.title: Statistics and Visualization
analysis.desc: Cover baseline tables, survival models, regressions, sensitivity checks, and publication-grade figures.

writing.title: Manuscript Writing
writing.desc: Turn results into methods, results, discussion, cover letters, and rebuttal drafts.

pipeline.title: Research Project Pipeline
pipeline.desc: Break ideas into evidence, protocol, execution, reporting, and dissemination tasks for agents to run.

plugins.title: Plugin Ecosystem
plugins.subtitle: Connect team methods, private data, and specialized tools into one workspace.

skillUpload.title: Team Skill Upload
skillUpload.desc: Package local SOPs, statistical templates, and code snippets into reusable team capabilities.

agentRouting.title: Smart Routing
agentRouting.desc: Recommend the right skills by research scenario and reduce manual prompt maintenance.

privateStack.title: Private Extensions
privateStack.desc: Support BYOK, internal databases, and institution-specific plugins for long-running teams.

docs.title: Docs and Help
docs.subtitle: Keep common help entry points in one tab, then open the full docs when needed.

api.title: API and Deployment Docs
api.desc: Review service endpoints, deployment variables, auth, and local/server startup notes.

skills.title: Skill Guide
skills.desc: Learn how to upload, categorize, call, and maintain team research skills.

database.title: Database Access Notes
database.desc: Map data-source connection, variable retrieval, export packages, and permission boundaries.

pipeline.title: Research Pipeline Manual
pipeline.desc: Move projects through idea, protocol, execution, reporting, and dissemination stages.

contact.title: Need procurement support or custom service?
contact.desc: For team seats, private deployment, plugin migration, or database access, we can configure MedHelp around your actual research workflow.

items.title: Beta access
items.desc: Best for trying the personal workspace and skill library first.

items.title: Team rollout
items.desc: Best for labs, departments, or institutions that need shared governance.

items.title: Plugin migration
items.desc: Turn existing SOPs, scripts, and templates into callable plugins.

plans.title: Choose Your Research Plan
plans.subtitle: Free covers the basic project and chat experience. Pro unlocks automation, durable knowledge, and the complete research workspace.

free.name: FREE
free.desc: Try basic projects, chat, and file browsing.
free.period: Best for exploring the MedHelp workflow

pro.name: PRO
pro.desc: The complete research workspace with automation.
pro.period: Best for monitoring, cohort studies, and manuscripts
features: Project memory and full conversation archive
Codex, advanced file actions, and higher limits

features.title: Everything You Need for
features.subtitle: A purpose-built workspace that understands the clinical research lifecycle.

chat.title: Agent Chat
chat.desc: Multi-model conversations with seamless switching between Claude Code and Codex. Context-aware prompting for clinical research workflows.

evidence.title: Evidence Pipeline
evidence.desc: Five-stage clinical evidence management: intake, protocol design, study execution, reporting, and dissemination — all tracked and auditable.

knowledge.title: Variable Knowledge
knowledge.desc: Structured variable knowledge base with PubMed discovery integration. Capture, cite, and trace evidence across your entire research portfolio.

files.title: Files & Git
files.desc: Built-in file manager with syntax highlighting, diff viewer, and Git integration. Version control your research assets alongside your code.

tasks.title: Task Automation
tasks.desc: TaskMaster-powered task decomposition with automatic PRD generation. Break complex studies into tracked, executable subtasks with AI assistance.

pipeline.title: Five Stages. One Workspace.
pipeline.subtitle: A structured pipeline that mirrors the clinical research lifecycle from evidence gathering to publication.

intake.title: Evidence Intake
intake.desc: Systematic literature search, PubMed integration, and automated evidence grading. Capture variables, endpoints, and inclusion criteria from published studies.

design.title: Protocol Design
design.desc: AI-assisted protocol drafting with structured templates. Define study arms, endpoints, sample size calculations, and statistical analysis plans.

execution.title: Study Execution
execution.desc: Track enrollment, data collection, and adverse events. Run analyses directly on your compute environment with integrated workflow tools.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.desc: Generate tables, figures, and statistical summaries. Export publication-ready manuscripts with proper citations and CONSORT/STROBE compliance.

dissemination.title: Dissemination
dissemination.desc: Prepare submissions for journals and conferences. Archive datasets, share reproducible analysis notebooks, and track research impact.

compatibility.title: Connect to
compatibility.subtitle: From relational databases to document stores — connect, query, analyze, and visualize your clinical research data directly.

prosCons.title: Real
prosCons.subtitle: Built for medical research workflows, with setup and review still required.

cons.title: Watchpoints
cons.subtitle: Data, permissions, and workflow need setup

pros.title: Practical Strengths
pros.subtitle: Common research work in one workspace

cta.title: Ready to Accelerate
cta.subtitle: Deploy MedHelp in minutes and streamline your clinical research workflow with AI-powered automation.

footer.builtWith: Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js
